id: \rI've been trying to beat Rudy for a long time, but he is too strong.
en: \rI've been trying to beat Rudy for a long time, but he is too strong.
it: \rÈ da tanto che cerco di battere Rudy, ma è troppo forte.

id: \bThe Gym Leader here uses many different kinds of Pokémon; he has one of almost every type.
en: \bThe Gym Leader here uses many different kinds of Pokémon; he has one of almost every type.
it: \bIl Capopalestra di qui usa tanti tipi diversi di Pokémon: ne ha uno di quasi ogni tipo.

id: \bRudy is my brother. Go easy on him!
en: \bRudy is my brother. Go easy on him!
it: \bRudy è mio fratello. Vacci piano con lui!
